<thought>We have located the training and test CSV files for the sulphide dataset. We'll train the XGBoost regression model using the provided hyperparameters and save the model checkpoint to the designated directory.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
  "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_2/sulphide_ml_dataset/train.csv",
  "test_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_2/sulphide_ml_dataset/test.csv",
  "model_save_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_2/trained_xgboost_model.pkl",
  "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
  "hyperparameters": {
    "n_estimators": 200,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1
  }
